## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 400 retinal image captures during June 2023. This represents the site’s reported activity for the month. The captures were submitted for image-quality assessment and subsequent grading in line with the clinic’s routine workflow.

## Image quality

Of the 400 captures, 23 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.8, as reported for the month. These images could not proceed through the standard grading process and should be considered when reviewing the overall performance of the service. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the reporting period.

## Grading

Grading identified 86 referable results. These outcomes require appropriate clinical follow-up through the established referral pathway. The median grading lag was 2, indicating the midpoint time between image submission and completion of grading for the month. The results provide a summary of activity, image quality and grading performance at Harbour Eye Clinic for June 2023.
